name: Aristotle
source:
"Oh dear... who is our opponent?"

Based on Aristotle, a legendary-like Greek philosopher and scientist.

The highly capable military officer who's also taken it upon herself to educate [url=/c5152]Alexander[/url] to become a good king. It is said that the overwhelming strength of the Macedonian forces is all by grace of Aristotle's teachings. She is acquainted with various academics and loved by everyone from soldies to civilians because she impartially shares her knowledge with them all.

Aristotle has a strong desire for marriage despite being extremely shy in front of people of the opposite sex. She reads away guidebooks on how to get along with men.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char13b]English official site[/url]]
